blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: oollim is a locally executable system for evaluating L2 English pronunciation accuracy, fluency, and prosody on a consumer computer. The system combines pretrained XLS-R, XEUS, and PhoneticXeus representations with reference-text features and ridge regressions trained on SpeechOcean762, the Korean Learners' L2 Speech Corpus (English), J-AESOP, and their combinations. On 305 independently held-out recordings assessed by three expert raters, several ridge configurations substantially outperform archived Azure API scores obtained in January 2026 in both Spearman correlation and quadratic weighted kappa across all three constructs. These results support expert speech evaluation on consumer hardware using pretrained representations and construct-specific regressions, without neural-model fine-tuning or calibration on the private evaluation data.
blocks.zh: oollim是一个当地可执行的系统,用于评价L2英语发音的准确性,流利性,以及消费计算机上的发音. 该系统结合了预训XLS-R,XEUS,和PhoneticXeus表示法与参考文本特征和脊回向法,SpeechOcean762,韩语学习者L2 Speech Corpus(英语),J-AESOP,及其组合. 在3名专家评分员评估的305次独立保存的录音中,几个山脊配置的成绩大大超过2026年1月在斯皮尔曼关联和四相加权卡帕三种构造中获得的Azure API分数。 这些结果支持使用预先训练的表示和构造特定回归,对消费者硬件进行专家语音评价,而不对私人评价数据进行神经模型微调或校正。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Pronunciation evaluation requires distinct judgments of accuracy, fluency, and prosody. Accuracy concerns the realization of expected consonants and vowels [ 1 , 2 ] ; fluency concerns speech continuity, including speed, pauses, and repairs [ 3 , 4 ] ; prosody concerns rhythm, stress, intonation, and phrasing [ 5 , 6 ] . These related dimensions inform pronunciation judgments but are not interchangeable [ 2 , 7 ] . Segmental accuracy concerns distinctions between speech sounds, whereas intelligibility concerns what listeners understand and comprehensibility their perceived processing difficulty; a noticeable accent need not prevent understanding [ 8 ] . An accuracy score does not directly measure intelligibility. Fluency research distinguishes underlying processing efficiency, observable timing, and perceived smoothness [ 9 ] . Speech rate, pause placement and duration, and repairs contribute differently to listener judgments, so fluency is not simply speaking quickly [ 3 , 4 ] . Prosody organizes speech through lexical stress, prominence, phrasing, and intonation, with pitch, duration, and intensity providing interacting cues [ 5 , 6 ] . Appropriate stress can improve listeners’ recall and evaluations of a speaker [ 10 ] ; contextual appropriateness therefore matters alongside acoustic variation. Although their acoustic correlates overlap, the three constructs require separate targets and useful measurements for educators; the scores need not come from the same representation combination or scoring function. XLS-R, XEUS, and PhoneticXeus provide complementary sources of speech information. This study examines whether these existing models, combined with modest supervised scoring functions, can support expert L2 English evaluation on an ordinary gaming PC. With computationally expensive pretraining supplied by the original model developers, the contribution is the selection and combination of their representations, reference-text evidence, and corpus-specific assessment supervision. The central evidence is an external evaluation on independently collected, privately held recordings, while training-corpus development results serve model selection and reproducibility and are provided in the repository. The external comparison includes Azure pronunciation assessment [ 11 ] , seven ridge-training families, and two human agreement baselines, with both rank association and numerical agreement measured. This design separates three questions: whether scores rank recordings similarly to human judgments, whether they agree on the numerical scale, and how that agreement compares with agreement among the human raters [ 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 发音评价需要对准确性、流利性和通俗性作出不同的判断。 准确性涉及预期相和元音的实现[1,2];流利性涉及语音的连续性,包括速度,暂停,和修复[3,4];通体性涉及节奏,应力,入能,和用词[5,6]. 这些相关维度为发音判断提供信息,但不可互换[2,7]. 部分准确性涉及语音的区别,而不通晓性则涉及听众理解和理解他们所意识到的处理困难;明显的口音不需要妨碍理解[8]。 精度分数不能直接衡量不显明. 流利性研究区分了基本的处理效率,可观测的时间,以及感知的平滑性[9]. 语音速率、暂停放置和持续时间以及修理对听众的判断有不同的贡献,因此流利并非只是快速发言[3、4]。 Prosody通过语法压力、突出、措辞和入声来组织演讲,投出、持续和强度提供相互作用的提示[5、6]。 适当的压力可以改善听众的召回和评估发言者的情况[10];因此,与声调变化一样,背景上的适当性也很重要。 虽然它们的相声相关,但是这三种构象需要针对教育者分别进行目标和有用的测量;分数不需要来自相同的表现组合或分数函数. XLS-R,XEUS,和PhoneticXeus提供了语音信息的互补来源. 本研究探讨了这些现有模型,加上适度的有监督的评分功能,是否能够支持专家L2英语在普通游戏PC上的评价. 由原始模型开发者提供的计算昂贵的预训,其贡献是选择和组合其表述、参考文本证据和针对具体实体的评估监督。 中心证据是对独立收集的、私人保存的录音进行外部评价,而培训-公司发展成果则为模型选择和复制服务,由储存库提供。 外部比较包括Azure发音评估[11],7个山脊训练家庭,以及两个人类协议基线,分级关系和数字协议都有测量. 这一设计将三个问题分开:分数是否与人类判断相似,它们是否就数值表达成一致,以及这种协议与人类评分者之间的一致如何比较[12].

blocks.en: 2 Speech models and related work
blocks.zh: 2个 演讲模式和相关工作

blocks.en: Automated assessment has long combined acoustic evidence with supervised mappings to human judgments. SpeechRater derives pronunciation, fluency, and other proficiency features from recognized speech and uses learned scoring models [ 13 ] . Neural assessment extends this approach by learning representations and their relationship to rated performance. GOPT uses phonetic posterior features and canonical phone identities in a transformer trained jointly on phone-, word-, and utterance-level human annotations [ 14 ] . On SpeechOcean762, the 2,500-utterance training and test partitions provide the same assessment targets on different recordings [ 15 , 14 ] . The scoring model is trained on human ratings and evaluated against ratings of held-out recordings. Kim et al. adapt wav2vec 2.0 and HuBERT with CTC, then combine contextual representations and reference text in a bidirectional LSTM scoring model, evaluating against expert scores on separate partitions of Korean learner speech and SpeechOcean762 [ 16 ] . Cai et al. connect hierarchical neural assessment to applied-linguistics constructs, adapting scoring toward human judgments of segmental, suprasegmental, and temporal performance [ 2 ] . Saito et al. use regression over phonological, prosodic, and temporal features to predict comprehensibility, testing generalization on additional recordings and an interview task [ 17 ] . These studies train scoring models against human ratings and assess multiple dimensions or transfer to new data, although differences in targets, rating panels, and metrics prevent direct numerical comparison with oollim . XLS-R extends cross-lingual self-supervised speech representation learning [ 18 ] ; XEUS learns multilingual representations across thousands of languages [ 19 ] ; PhoneticXeus adds phone recognition and supplies hidden representations and phone evidence [ 20 ] . In oollim their pretrained weights remain unchanged, while ridge regression learns regularized linear mappings to assessment labels [ 21 ] . oollim combines these representations with reference-phone diagnostics and construct-specific regressions trained on one or more corpora, then evaluates them on an independently collected passage-reading cohort to test transfer beyond holding out recordings within a training corpus. Earlier neural-head, temporal, and acoustic-feature experiments motivated the ridge baseline; the evaluation does not cover every neural assessment architecture. The comparison therefore focuses on the external transfer of compact scoring models.
blocks.zh: 自动评估长期以来将声学证据与受监督的图谱与人类判断相结合. SpeechRater从公认的语音中得到发音,流利等能力特征,并使用所学得分模型[13]. 神经评估通过学习表现及其与被评分的性能的关系来扩展这种方法. GOPT在联合培训的变压器中使用了电话后音特征和犬形电话身份,这些变压器都使用电话,单词,和口语层面的人语说明[14]. 在SpeechOcean762上,2500口腔训练和测试分区在不同录音上提供了同样的评估目标[15,14]. 评分模式接受关于人类评分的培训,并根据被搁置录音的评分进行评价。 Kim等编. 将 wav2vec 2.0 和 HuBERT 与 CTC 相适应,然后在双向 LSTM 评分模型中结合背景表述和参考文本,对照专家对韩国学习者演讲和SpeechOcean762 的分数进行评分. SpeechOcean762 [16]. 蔡等编. 将层次神经评估与应用语言构造联系起来,使分分数适应人类对分层、超层和时间性能的判断[2]。 斋藤等. 利用对相声、流派和时间特征的回归来预测可理解性,测试额外录音的通俗化和采访任务[17]。 尽管目标、评分板和衡量标准不同, 无法直接与Oollim进行比较。 XLS-R扩展了跨语言自我监督的语音表现学习[. 18]; XEUS学习了数千种语言的多语种表述 [19]; PhoneticXeus增加了电话识别功能并提供了隐藏表述和电话证据 [20]. 在Oollim语中,其预受训练的重量保持不变,而脊回学常规化线性映射到评估标签[21]. oollim将这些表示法与参考电话诊断法和针对一个或一个以上蝎子的构造回学法结合起来,然后在独立收集的通道读取组中对其进行评价,以测试在培训书中保存记录以外的转移。 早期的神经-头,时间,和声学-地貌实验激发了脊基;评价并不涵盖每一个神经评估架构. 因此,比较的重点是契约评分模型的外部转让。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Audio, reference text, and representations
blocks.zh: 3.1 音频、参考文本和陈述

blocks.en: Whole-recording embeddings and phone diagnostics derived from required reference text provide the scoring inputs. FFmpeg [ 22 ] decodes audio-bearing containers; a common preprocessing path averages channels to mono and resamples to 16 kHz. The full recording is processed as one utterance, without averaging separately scored sentences. Each encoder adapter returns frame embeddings and valid-frame lengths or masks, with XLS-R 300M, XEUS, and PhoneticXeus each providing 1,024-dimensional frame representations in the configurations used here [ 18 , 19 , 20 ] . Statistics pooling [ 23 ] , using masked temporal means and population standard deviations, with 10 − 5 10^{-5} added to the variance before the square root, yields 2,048-dimensional utterance vectors. Model revisions and implementation checksums are pinned in the repository. A pinned CMU pronunciation dictionary supplies ARPAbet reference pronunciations [ 24 ] . ARPAbet–IPA correspondences are documented in CMU dictionary tools [ 25 ] ; the versioned mapping in oollim converts dictionary phones to the PhoneticXeus token inventory, including explicit diphthong splitting and unstressed-vowel handling. PhoneticXeus provides frame-level phone probabilities and a greedy connectionist temporal classification (CTC) sequence [ 20 , 26 ] . Seventeen diagnostics summarize phone probabilities and entropy [ 27 ] , blank behavior, predicted and expected phone rates, reference coverage, relative sequence length, edit operations [ 28 ] , and CTC negative log-likelihoods normalized by frame and reference-token counts [ 26 ] . The CTC calculation sums valid paths for the expected phone sequence rather than assigning a single forced alignment [ 26 ] . These features combine pronunciation, timing, and uncertainty evidence; they are not error-free phonetic diagnoses. Out-of-vocabulary references are rejected explicitly. The evaluated accuracy configuration uses XEUS + PhoneticXeus + IPA diagnostics, whereas fluency and prosody use XLS-R + XEUS. The scoring pipeline can select a representation combination and training family separately for each construct.

blocks.en: 3.2 Training corpora and label mappings
blocks.zh: 3.2 培训公司和标签绘图

blocks.en: Three research corpora supply assessment labels mapped to a common 0–10 range. SpeechOcean762 supplies utterance accuracy, fluency, and prosodic ratings on the 0–10 scale. The official SpeechOcean762 training partition is divided by speaker into 2,000 training and 500 development utterances; the official test partition is excluded. The Korean Learners’ L2 Speech Corpus (English) [ 29 ] is distributed as AIHub dataset 71463 [ 30 ] . Eligible Training PRN recordings yield 2,699 training and 636 development examples. The corpus rubric rates pronunciation accuracy (segment clarity and errors) and prosodic fluency (stress, rhythm, intonation, rate, and pauses) on 1–5 scales [ 29 ] . The supplied articulation score trains accuracy, while the prosodic-fluency score trains both fluency and prosody after mapping with 2.5 ​ ( y − 1 ) 2.5(y-1) . J-AESOP [ 31 ] supplies 180 Japanese L2 speakers reading the North Wind and Sun passage (task 6_01). Deterministic speaker partitions allocate 108 recordings to training, 36 to development, and 36 to a reserved partition; native controls are excluded. Ratings from 16 raters across three sections are averaged per construct. Segment ratings supply accuracy, alongside fluency and prosody; 10 ​ ( y − 1 ) / 9 10(y-1)/9 maps the 1–10 source scale to 0–10. Partitions are speaker-disjoint within each corpus to separate development from fitting [ 32 ] . In the Korean Learners’ L2 Speech Corpus (English), recorder identities linked by identical decoded audio are grouped before splitting; duration and dictionary-coverage checks determine eligibility. Exact sampling rules, audio audits, mappings, and development results are retained in the reproduction package. Equal numerical ranges do not establish score equivalence [ 33 ] ; the shared prosody/fluency target does not provide an independent fluency annotation. The mappings permit joint fitting while retaining these differences in supervision.

blocks.en: 3.3 Ridge fitting and family selection
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 接岭和家庭选择

blocks.en: Seven training families compare single-corpus and mixed-corpus supervision. The single-corpus families are speechocean , korean , and aesop ; korean abbreviates the Korean Learners’ L2 Speech Corpus (English) in model identifiers. The pairs are koreanocean , aesopocean , and koreanaesop , while the three-corpus family is aesopkoreanocean . In the matched family procedure, a recording from corpus c c receives weight w i = 1 / ( K ​ n c ) w_{i}=1/(Kn_{c}) , where K K is the number of included corpora and n c n_{c} their respective training counts. Training-only weighted means and standard deviations standardize features [ 34 ] ; a block of width d b d_{b} receives gain 2048 / d b \sqrt{2048/d_{b}} . Coordinates with standard deviation below 10 − 8 10^{-8} use scale 1. Each construct fits a weighted ridge objective [ 21 , 34 ] min β , b ∑ i w i ​ ( y i − z i ⊤ ​ β − b ) 2 + α ​ ∥ β ∥ 2 2 , \min_{\beta,b}\quad\sum_{i}w_{i}(y_{i}-z_{i}^{\top}\beta-b)^{2}+\alpha\lVert\beta\rVert_{2}^{2}, (1) with an unpenalized intercept. Penalties { 0.001 , 0.01 , 0.1 , 1 , 10 , 100 } \{0.001,0.01,0.1,1,10,100\} are compared using mean development Spearman correlation over the included corpora; ties prefer lower mean MAE and then larger regularization, keeping selection on development data [ 32 ] . Multi-output array storage does not couple the separate squared-loss objectives. All seven ridge families were scored for the present study. The deployed SpeechOcean ridge used an earlier tuning procedure, including development accuracy MAE, and its scores were carried forward from the first evaluation round rather than replaced with matched-refit predictions. The retained deployment is version speechocean-stella-v2 ; the other six families use the matched seven-families-v1 heads. Request metadata are retained where available; the original SpeechOcean scores were imported rather than regenerated. Public-development selection retained koreanocean for accuracy and aesopkoreanocean for fluency and prosody; these ranking-oriented research selections are distinct from the column maxima in the external table and are not claimed to maximize external QWK. The representation sensitivity analysis is separate from the fixed-combination external evaluation. A sensitivity check of all 315 family–construct–representation configurations on public development data retained the overall construct-specific selections under the 0.01 Spearman improvement threshold and corpus-level degradation and uncertainty checks recorded before fitting in the October 18, 2026 ablation protocol; the full protocol and results are provided in the reproduction materials. All coefficient estimation, preprocessing fitting, and score calibration exclude private evaluation ratings.

blocks.en: 3.4 Local execution and capacity
blocks.zh: 3.4 当地执行和能力

blocks.en: Local operation was verified on consumer hardware using CPU inference. On the Windows gaming PC (Intel Core i7-11700K, 32 GB physical RAM, Ubuntu under WSL2 with approximately 24 GiB available RAM and 8 GiB swap), an archived 120-second capacity test completed in approximately 169 seconds, reaching 22.52 GiB peak process resident memory and 5.51 GiB peak system-wide swap use. The installed RTX 3080 was not required for that inference test. A separate Apple Silicon installation test processed an 8.21-second public recording in 42.13 seconds with four CPU threads, including decoding, all three encoders, phone features, and scoring. Software versions for the same WSL installation are recorded in the appendices. These single-run checks establish operation rather than representative throughput; the released duration limit is 120 seconds, and long recordings can require substantial RAM and swap.
blocks.zh: 利用CPU推论在消费者硬件上验证了本地操作. 在Windows Gaming PC(Intel Core i7-1700K,32 GB物理RAM,WSL2下的Ubuntu,约24个GiB可用RAM和8个GiB互换)上,存档120秒容量测试约169秒后完成,达到22.52个GiB最高峰进程常住内存和5.51个GiB最高峰全系统互换使用. 已安装的RTX 3080不需要用于这一推断试验。 单独的Apple硅安装测试在42.13秒内处理了8.21秒的公开录制,有4个CPU线程,包括解码器,所有3个编码器,电话功能,和分数. 同一WSL安装的软件版本记录在附录中. 这些单跑检查确立了运行,而不是代表性的吞吐量;发布的持续时间限制为120秒,而长录音可能需要大量的RAM和互换.

blocks.en: 4 External evaluation
blocks.zh: 4 外部评价

blocks.en: 4.1 Independent recordings and ratings
blocks.zh: 4.1 独立录音和评级

blocks.en: The collection comprised university EFL learners from China ( n = 98 n=98 ), Korea ( n = 101 n=101 ), and Japan ( n = 107 n=107 ), who recorded the same “Please Call Stella” passage on personal smartphones. One recording was excluded because of its length, leaving 305 samples. The three university professors had approximately 20–30 years of teaching experience, including pronunciation instruction, Cambridge English speaking assessment, and high-stakes speech rating. Based in those countries, the raters calibrated their judgments on separate recordings spanning proficiency levels, discussing discrepancies to establish shared criteria for accuracy, fluency, and prosody. Each professor then rated every recording independently in randomized order, blinded to participant identity and automated scores, using a 0–100 scale in five-point increments. The private evaluation recordings and ratings were held out from model training, hyperparameter tuning, and score calibration. The original human ratings and Azure API scores are archival; the seven ridge families were evaluated for the present study against those existing ratings. Azure scores were obtained in January 2026 using the en-US locale, with the Stella reference text supplied and each complete recording assessed as a whole. The returned accuracy, fluency, and prosody scores were retained. The service revision and remaining request options were not retained in the supplied evaluation archive; the comparison therefore concerns those recorded API outputs rather than a newly standardized Azure benchmark.
blocks.zh: 该集由来自中国(n=98n=98),韩国(n=101n=101)和日本(n=107n=107)的EFL大学学员组成,他们在个人智能手机上记录了同样的"请叫Stella"通道. 一份记录由于长度而被排除在外,留下了305个样本。 三位大学教授有大约20-30年的教学经验,包括发音指导,剑桥英语演讲评估,以及高考的演讲评分. 在这些国家,评分者根据跨越熟练程度的单独记录校正判断,讨论不一致之处,以确定准确性、流利度和流畅度的共同标准。 然后,每位教授按照随机顺序对每张录音进行独立评分,对参与者身份和自动分数视而不见,使用5分递增的0-100分表. 私人评价录音和评分从模式培训、超参数调试和分数校正中取出。 原始人类收视率和Azure API分数为档案;根据这些现有收视率,对七个山脊家族进行了本作的评价. 2026年1月使用en-US地块获得Azure分数,提供Stella参考文本,每张完整录制被整体评估. 返回的准确度、流利度和正率分数被保留下来。 所提供的评价档案中没有保留服务修订和其余请求选项;因此,比较涉及的是记录的API产出,而不是新标准化的Azure基准。

blocks.en: 4.2 Metrics and human baselines
blocks.zh: 4.2 计量和人类基线

blocks.en: Evaluation distinguishes rank consistency from numerical agreement [ 35 , 12 ] . Spearman’s ρ \rho measures rank association [ 36 ] . Quadratic weighted kappa (QWK) measures chance-corrected agreement with squared category-distance penalties [ 37 ] ; this study uses fixed integer categories 0–100 and half-up rounding. Model outputs are multiplied by ten; no calibration is fitted. Predictions are clipped to 0–100 for QWK, including bootstrap replicates, whereas Spearman retains raw predictions. A reference mean requires all three human scores; partial means are not substituted. Human–Human pairwise agreement averages the three pairwise statistics, whereas Human–Human consensus agreement averages each rater’s agreement with the mean of the other two, never including that rater in their own reference. For each system, the three-rater row compares the system’s scores with the mean of all humans, while the two-rater row averages the three separate agreement statistics against the three possible two-human means. Statistics are averaged, not observations or reference means pooled. The two-rater system row and Human–Human consensus row therefore provide the appropriate reference-size comparison when recomputed on the same recordings. Percentile 95% intervals resample speaker clusters jointly, recomputing all component statistics within each replicate [ 38 , 39 ] . The supplementary marginal intervals retain the supplied evaluation export (2,000 replicates, seed 42). Additional paired comparisons use 200,000 bootstrap replicates (seed 42), subtracting statistics within each replicate on the same sampled recordings. An independent 200,000-replicate run (seed 2026) produced the same interval-exclusion decisions for all contrasts. Each unique recording URL is treated as one speaker. Both percentile 95% intervals and Bonferroni-adjusted intervals across all 90 reported differences are supplied: eight systems versus human consensus and seven ridges versus Azure, for three constructs and two metrics. These post-evaluation comparisons condition on the observed raters and fitted models; adjustment covers the reported contrasts, not the preceding model search. The appendices report all reference comparisons and intervals for the same 305 recordings. Matched reference sizes and cohorts make the human and model estimates comparable.
blocks.zh: 评价将一致性与数字协议区分开来[35、12]。 Spearman 的 ^\rho 度量衡 排名协会 [36]. 四方加权kappa(QWK)用平方的类别-距离处罚来测量偶然修正的协议[37];本研究采用固定整数类别0-100和半圆. 模型产出乘以10;没有安装校正。 QWK的预测被剪至0–100,包括靴子复制,而Spearman保留了原始预测. 参考指要求所有三个人类分数;部分手段不被取而代之. 人与人之间的对等协议是三种对等统计的平均值,而人与人之间的共识协议是每个对等协议与另外两种对等协议的平均值的平均值,从未将该对等协议纳入它们自己的参照范围。 对每个系统来说,三等分行将系统的分数与所有人类的平均值进行比较,而两等分行则将三种可能的二等分行的分别协议统计值与三种可能的二等分行方法相提并论. 统计是平均的,而不是观察或参考表示集合。 因此,两个评分系统行和人类共识行在重算同一录音时提供了适当的参考大小比较。 百分率95%的间隔重取主讲人组群,重取每个组群内的所有组成部分统计数据复制[38,39]. 补充的边距保留了所提供的评价出口(2 000个复制品,种子42个)。 额外的对等比较使用20万只靴子复制(种子42),减去每只复制中在同一样本录音上的统计数据。 独立的20万复制跑道(种子为2026)对所有对比性产生了相同的间隔-排除决定. 每个独有的录制URL都被视为一个发音. 在所报告的所有90个差异中,提供了95%的间隔和Bonferroni调整的间隔:三个构件和两个度数的8个系统与人类共识对比,7个脊与Azure对比。 这些评价后比较条件涉及所观察到的评分和配有的模型;调整涵盖所报告的对比,而不是先前的模型搜索。 附录报告同样的305个录音的所有参考比较和间隔。 匹配的参考大小和组群使得人和模型的估计具有可比性.

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that every ridge family exceeds Azure in rank association across all three constructs, with mixed-corpus families generally strongest. Model correlations also exceed the human consensus baseline, but numerical agreement presents a different pattern: the leading accuracy model exceeds the human QWK baseline, whereas fluency and prosody remain below the human QWK baseline. Several families outperform Azure on both metrics, although the advantage is not universal for QWK. No family leads both metrics across all constructs, supporting construct-specific scoring choices. Across all 90 contrasts, Bonferroni-adjusted paired intervals remain above zero for every ridge–Azure Spearman difference and for koreanocean accuracy QWK versus human consensus. aesopocean , koreanaesop , and aesopkoreanocean also exceed human-consensus rank agreement across all three constructs under that adjustment; korean does so for prosody. No ridge has a positive adjusted QWK difference from human consensus for fluency or prosody. Full differences and score-distribution summaries appear in the appendices; external family rankings remain descriptive.
blocks.zh: 表1显示,每个山脊家族都超过 Azure与所有三种结构的等级关系, 与混血儿家庭一般最强。 模型关联性也超过了人类共识基线,但数值协议呈现出不同的模式:领先的精度模型超过人类QWK基线,而流畅度和正率仍然低于人类QWK基线. 有几个家庭在两个衡量标准上都比Azure好,尽管对卡塔尔来说这一优势并不普遍。 没有一家人领导所有结构的两种衡量标准,支持特定结构的评分选择。 在所有90个对比点中,Bonferroni调整后的对接间隔在每道脊-Azure Spearman差和Korean Ocean精度-QWK与人类共识之间仍然高于零。 Aesop Ocean, koreanaesop, 和 Aesopkorean Ocean 也超越了人类共识等级协议, 无脊无有正经调整的QWK与人类共识的流利或活性差异. 全部差异和分数分配摘要载于附录;外部家庭排名仍然是描述性的。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: The results favor selecting scorers by construct and intended use. Public-development selection prioritizes rank correlation; users seeking numerical feedback should also consider QWK, for which the external table favors koreanocean accuracy and speechocean fluency/prosody. Those external preferences remain descriptive rather than independently validated deployment choices. Several mixed-corpus families have higher correlations but lower QWK values than single-corpus families, so scorer selection depends on whether the intended use requires ranking, numerical agreement, or both; no single family needs to generate all three constructs. Azure scores average 23.63, 27.88, and 10.57 points above the three-human means for accuracy, fluency, and prosody, respectively; these offsets help explain low QWK despite positive rank associations. No correction was fitted to remove those offsets. XEUS alone approaches the retained combinations on public-development macro correlation (gaps of 0.0017 for accuracy, 0.0016 for fluency, and 0.0041 for prosody in the selected families), so the sweep does not establish a substantial benefit from every additional encoder. A lighter XEUS-only system warrants separate external evaluation; the present private results apply to the evaluated combinations. Korean-only fluency and prosody share features and targets, so their predictions do not constitute independent learning of two constructs. Human baselines also answer different questions, with agreement against a two-rater consensus generally higher than agreement with one other human because averaging reduces some rater-specific variation. On the same reference pairs and recordings, leading model point estimates exceed the Human–Human consensus baseline for rank association across constructs and for accuracy QWK, whereas fluency and prosody QWK remain below that baseline. The advantage over human agreement therefore depends on the construct and metric, with paired uncertainty reported in the appendices. External family rankings are descriptive rather than prospectively validated selections [ 32 ] . Agreement with human ratings supports a particular score interpretation, rather than every educational use of the scores [ 40 ] . The software, trained scoring weights, model configurations, and reproduction materials are available at https://github.com/cburst/oollim , subject to the licenses documented in the repository. Practical scorer selection should therefore consider the target construct, agreement metric, and teaching context.
blocks.zh: 结果倾向于通过构建和预期用途选择计分者。 公共-发展选择优先考虑等级关系;寻求数字反馈的用户还应考虑QWK,为此,外部表格倾向于韩国海洋的准确度和语音海洋流利/流利度。 这些外部偏好仍然是描述性的,而不是经过独立验证的部署选择。 几个混血子公司家族的关联性较高,但QWK值低于单人子公司家族,因此计分员的选择取决于预期用途需要排名,数字一致,还是两者兼有;没有单一家族需要生成所有三种构造. Azure平均得分23.63分,27.88分和10.57分分别高于三人制的精度,流利度和通畅度;这些抵消有助于解释尽管排名关系为正,但QWK低. 没有为去除这些冲抵而进行更正。 光是XEUS就公共-发展宏观关联性(精确度为0.007;流利度为0.0016;精度为0.0041),所选择的家庭就采用保留组合法,因此扫荡法并没有确立从每一个额外的编码器中获得实质性好处。 较轻的XEUS只使用一个系统,需要单独进行外部评价;目前的私人结果适用于被评价的组合. 韩国独活流利和活泼性具有共同的特征和目标,因此他们的预测并不构成对两种构造的独立学习. 人类基线也回答了不同的问题,与双方共识达成的协议一般高于与其他人类的协议,因为平均可以减少某些特定比率的差异。 在同样的参考对和记录中,领先的模型点估计超过了人与人之间关于跨结构的等级联系和准确性的共识基线,而流利和优异的QWK仍然低于这一基线。 因此,相对于人类协议而言,其优势取决于构建和度量,附录中报告了成对的不确定性。 外部家族排名是描述性的,而不是经过预期验证的选择[32]. 与人类评分一致支持特定分数解释,而不是每一次教育使用分数[40]. 软件、训练有素的分数、模型配置和复制材料可在https://github.com/cburst/oollim查阅,但须符合存放处记录的许可证。 因此,实际计分员的选择应考虑目标构建、协议衡量和教学背景。

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: The evaluation supports conclusions about one passage and three university EFL settings. Recording-level scores permit paired analysis, but URL-based grouping assumes one recording per speaker. The cohort excludes one long recording, and the 120-second operational limit constrains input coverage. Score-scale mappings do not establish equivalent constructs: the Korean Learners’ L2 Speech Corpus (English) supplies shared prosody/fluency supervision, so differences among training families cannot be attributed solely to additional data. Speaker-disjoint fitting also cannot resolve possible upstream exposure of PhoneticXeus to learner corpora. The Azure service revision and remaining request options are unavailable, limiting exact replication of that comparator. The public-development ablation used a recorded selection rule, but neither bootstrap intervals nor contrast adjustment account for the entire model-search process. Broader claims require additional passages, populations, and intended uses [ 40 ] .
blocks.zh: 评价支持关于一个通道和三个大学EFL设置的结论。 记录级分数允许进行配对分析,但基于URL的分组假设每个演讲者一个记录. 该组不包括一个长录音,120秒的操作限制限制了输入范围。 分数比例绘图并不建立等效的构造:韩国学习者L2 Speech Corpus(英语)提供共享的Prosody/流利监督,因此培训家庭之间的差异不能仅仅归因于额外数据. 演讲者-脱节的装配也无法解决PhoneticXeus可能上游接触学习者Corpora的问题。 Azure服务修订版和其余请求选项无法使用,限制了该参照系统的确切复制。 公-发展衰竭采用有记录的选取规则,但无论是靴子间隔还是对比调整都没有说明整个模型搜索过程. 更广泛的索赔要求增加通道、人口和预期用途[40]。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: XLS-R, XEUS, and PhoneticXeus, combined with construct-specific ridge scoring, support local evaluation of L2 English accuracy, fluency, and prosody on the tested consumer configuration. The external passage evaluation shows strong rank association with human ratings, with every ridge family exceeding correlations from the archived January 2026 Azure API outputs across all three constructs. Numerical agreement varies by construct and training family and identifies different leading scorers from rank association, supporting the reporting of both metrics for each construct. The additional public-development ablation retained the overall construct-specific configurations under the 0.01 improvement rule. Additional passages and populations are needed to establish the scope of comparative human-agreement claims.
blocks.zh: XLS-R,XEUS,和PhoneticXeus,结合构造特异性的山脊分数,支持当地对L2英语精度,流利,被测试的消费者配置的评价. 外部通道评价显示与人类的评级有着很强的分级关系,从存档的2026年1月的Azure API输出到所有三种构造中,每个山脊家族都超过了相关. 数字协议因构建和培训家族而异,确定不同等级协会的主要得分者,支持报告每个构建的两种衡量标准。 根据0.01改进规则,新增的公用发展方案保留了总体建筑组合。 需要更多的通道和人口来确定比较人与协定要求的范围。

blocks.en: The same 305 complete recordings were resampled jointly 200,000 times (seed 42), treating each distinct recording URL as one speaker. Human consensus agreement averages each rater’s agreement with the other two; system agreement averages comparisons against those same three reference pairs. Differences are recomputed within each replicate. Intervals are percentile approximations; adjusted endpoints use probabilities 0.025 / 90 0.025/90 and 1 − 0.025 / 90 1-0.025/90 , covering 90 reported contrasts. A second 200,000-replicate run (seed 2026) reproduced all 90 interval-exclusion decisions; adjusted endpoints differed by at most 0.00367. Each adjusted tail now contains approximately 56 draws, although percentile intervals remain approximations. The supplementary marginal intervals above retain the original 2,000-replicate export. These post-evaluation comparisons condition on the panel and fitted models, without correcting for prior model exploration. All 48 system point estimates match the supplied export to numerical precision. Private scores were used only for evaluation; no coefficients or calibration were fitted.
blocks.zh: 同样的305个完整录音被联合复制了200 000次(种子42),把每个不同的记录URL当作一个发言者。 人类共识协议平均是每个评分员与其他两个评分员的协议;系统协议平均是同三个参考对的比较。 每次复制都重算出差异。 间距为百分位相近;调整后终点使用概率为0.025/90 0.025/90和1-0.025/90,涵盖90个报告对比. 第二次重复运行20万次(种子2026),重复了所有90个间隔排除决定;调整的终点最多为0.00367个。 每条经调整的尾巴现在含有约56道取出,不过百分位相距仍然相近. 上文补充的边距保留了原先的2000再出口。 在小组和安装模型时,这些评价后比较条件没有纠正以前的模型勘探。 所有48个系统点估计都将所提供的导出与数字精确相匹配。 私人分数仅用于评价;没有安装系数或校准。

blocks.en: Han, Chung, and Kim [ 29 ] define two 1–5 ratings: pronunciation accuracy and prosodic fluency. Accuracy addresses segmental clarity and errors; prosodic fluency combines stress, rhythm, intonation, speed, and pausing. The stored fields are articulationScore and prosodyScore . The second field supplies both fluency and prosody targets in the present implementation. Mapping 2.5 ​ ( y − 1 ) 2.5(y-1) produces 0, 2.5, 5, 7.5, and 10 from the five integer levels; mapping does not equate the rubric with SpeechOcean or create an independent fluency annotation. Korean-only heads use the same features and targets for both constructs, yielding identical predictions in the evaluated configuration. Source Mapped Accuracy (paraphrased) Prosodic fluency (paraphrased) 1 0 Extensive segmental difficulty; understanding is hard. Strongly disrupted prosody, very slow delivery, excessive pauses. 2 2.5 Frequent errors substantially burden understanding. Awkward prosody and slow delivery with prolonged, poorly placed pauses. 3 5 Recurring errors interfere with understanding. Uneven prosody and rate, with frequent or misplaced breaks. 4 7.5 Minor errors with little intelligibility impact. Mostly steady delivery with mild prosodic or pausing irregularities. 5 10 Clear segments without noticeable errors. Natural prosody, rate, and phrase boundaries.

blocks.en: D.2 Ablation protocol
blocks.zh: D.2 违约协议

blocks.en: The protocol was recorded before fitting on October 18, 2026 (repository: results/ablation-mac-v1/PROTOCOL.md ). The completed public-development sweep crossed seven training families, three constructs, and all 15 nonempty subsets of four feature blocks, giving 315 configurations and 945 corpus-level comparisons. X denotes XEUS, R XLS-R, P PhoneticXeus embeddings, and I the 17 phone diagnostics; I still requires PhoneticXeus inference, so omitting P does not necessarily avoid that encoder. Existing speaker-disjoint partitions, corpus-balanced weights, training-only standardization, and block gains were preserved. Each configuration selected a penalty from { 0.001 , 0.01 , 0.1 , 1 , 10 , 100 } \{0.001,0.01,0.1,1,10,100\} using equal-weight mean Spearman across all three development corpora, breaking ties by lower macro MAE and then larger penalty. This differs from the earlier included-corpus tuning; no corpus in these tables is an untouched cross-corpus test. Private recordings and ratings were excluded from fitting and selection.
blocks.zh: 协议在2026年10月18日(档案:成果/分析-mac-v1/PROTOCOL.md.)安装前录入. 已完成的公共-发展扫荡跨越了7个培训家庭、3个建筑,以及全部15个非空子集,包括4个地物块,提供了315个配置和945个体格的比较。 X表示XEUS,R XLS-R,PphoneticXeus嵌入法,而我则表示17个电话诊断法;我仍然需要PhoneticXeus推断法,所以省去P不一定能避免这个编码法. 保留了现有的演讲者-离子分区、体积平衡权重、只培训的标准化和块块收益。 每个组合从{0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100} 0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100} 使用等重的平均值 Spearman 在所有三个开发公司中选择一个处罚, 由更低的宏 MAE 打破关系, 然后给予更大的处罚. 这与早先包含的"公司"调音不同;这些表格中没有一个实体是未触及的"跨公司"测试. 私人录音和评分被排除在配制和选择之外。

blocks.en: Each candidate was compared with the fixed-feature baseline refitted under the same sweep protocol (X+P+I for accuracy, X+R otherwise). Candidates within 0.01 of the numerical best were shortlisted. Promotion required macro Spearman gain at least 0.01, no corpus correlation loss exceeding 0.02, no corpus MAE increase exceeding 0.10 on the 0–10 scale, and a positive lower 95% paired speaker-bootstrap bound (2,000 draws, seed 42). Fewer blocks were preferred where benefits were inconclusive. These screening gates do not constitute correction for all search comparisons. Deployed heads were not automatically replaced.
blocks.zh: 将每个候选人与同一扫瞄协议下的固定版面基线(XQP+I,准确性为XQR)进行比较。 在0.01名最佳人数范围内的候选人被选入短名单。 促销要求巨型Spearman至少获得0.01分,无实体关联损失超过0.02分,无实体MAE在0-10分量上增加超过0.10分,正比95%的配对扬声器-波茨夹带(2,000平分,种子42分 ) 。 在福利无定论的情况下,更倾向于减少区块。 这些筛选门不构成所有搜索比较的校正. 部署的头没有自动更换。

blocks.en: The decision table distinguishes numerical maxima from candidates passing the complete gate. Two AESOP-only alternatives passed: X+P for fluency and X+P+I for prosody. Their macro gains over the refitted AESOP baselines were 0.0341 (95% interval [0.0118, 0.0619]) for fluency and 0.0389 ([0.0161, 0.0638]) for prosody. Both exceed the 0.01 within-family threshold. Neither became the overall construct selection, and neither was substituted into the external seven-family evaluation. The overall retained choices were koreanocean X+P+I accuracy and aesopkoreanocean X+R fluency/prosody. Thus retaining the overall configurations does not mean that no individual family improved. XEUS-only macro correlations for the selected families were 0.8407 for koreanocean accuracy and 0.8644/0.8680 for aesopkoreanocean fluency/prosody, compared with 0.8424 and 0.8660/0.8721 for the retained combinations. These small development differences do not establish that all additional blocks are necessary; no XEUS-only private evaluation or matched resource benchmark is reported. The retained choices reflect the recorded development rule, not independently established representation optimality. Matrices report all 315 macro correlations; the accompanying CSV preserves all 945 corpus-specific correlations and MAEs.
blocks.zh: 该决定表将最高数字与通过完整大门的候选人区分开来。 两个只通过AESOP的替代品:流利的为QQP,正音的为QQP+I. 它们在重新调整的AESOP基线上的宏观收益是流利度为0.0341(95%相距[0.0118,0.0619]),顺通度为0.0389([0.0161,0.0638]). 两者都超过了0.01家庭内阈值。 也没有成为总体结构选择,也没有取代外部的7个家庭评价。 保留的总选择是韩国海洋++P+ 我精确度和洋相 流利度/品德 因此,保留总体结构并不意味着个人家庭没有任何改善。 XEUS对选定家庭的宏观关联性是:韩国海洋精度为0.8407;美国海洋精度为0.8644/0.8680;而保留组合为0.8424和0.8660/0.8721。 这些小的发展差异并不确定所有额外的区块都是必要的;没有只报告XEUS的私人评价或匹配的资源基准. 保留的选择反映了有记录的发展规则,而不是独立确定的最佳代表性。 Matrices报告所有315个宏观关联;与之相伴的CSV保留了所有945个生物体特异性关联和MAE.

The installation reports Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS, kernel 6.18.54.1-microsoft-standard-WSL2 , Python 3.11.17, and PyTorch 2.11.0+cu128 (CUDA build 12.8). blocks.en: Appendix F External rater backgrounds and procedure
blocks.zh: 附录F 外部评级人的背景和程序

blocks.en: The original human-evaluation study reports three experienced university raters. The Korea-based rater had more than 20 years of teaching experience, including a decade of university pronunciation instruction and speaking assessment. The Japan-based rater had nearly 30 years of teaching experience and more than 10 years as a Cambridge English speaking assessor. The China-based rater had nearly 20 years of experience, including high-stakes speech rating and university speaking assessment in an international joint-degree program. All three held professorial positions, as confirmed by the study author.
blocks.zh: 最初的人评价研究报告了三个经验丰富的大学评分. 以韩国为基地的评分师有20多年的教学经验,包括十年的大学发音教学和演讲评估. 以日本为基地的评分员有近30年的教学经验,并担任了10多年的剑桥英语评分员. 以中国为基地的评分者有近20年的经验,包括高考成绩的演讲评分和国际联合学位计划中的大学演讲评分. 三位都曾担任过教授职务,研究作者也证实了这一点。

blocks.en: Before evaluating the source recordings, the raters jointly assessed separate Stella recordings spanning proficiency levels and discussed discrepancies to establish shared criteria for segmental accuracy, fluency, and prosody. They then scored the 306 source recordings independently in randomized order, blinded to participant identity and automated scores. Ratings used a 0–100 scale in five-point increments, with communicative-effectiveness anchors labelled “High Intelligibility” above 85 and “Low Intelligibility” below 40. These are the documented general scale anchors, not a newly constructed analytic rubric for each dimension. The original study’s authors served as its raters; their ratings were reused as the external reference for the present model evaluation. One recording was subsequently excluded for excessive duration, leaving the matched 305-recording cohort. Human calibration used separate recordings and did not fit or calibrate any automated scorer.
blocks.zh: 在评价源录音之前,评分者共同评估了跨越熟练程度的单独斯黛拉录音,并讨论了差异,以建立分精度、流利度和通畅度的共同标准。 他们随后按照随机排列顺序独立打入了306个源录音,对参与者身份和自动分数视而不见. 评分在五分增量中采用0-100分制,以85分以上的 " 高能见度 " 为主播,40分以下为 " 低能见度 " 。 这些是文件所记载的一般尺度锚地,而不是每个维度所新建的解析分. 最初的研究作者是其评分者;他们的评分被重新用作本模型评价的外部参考. 一次录音随后因时间过长而被排除在外,留下了305个相应记录组别。 人类的校正使用单独的录音,并不符合或校正任何自动计分器.
